title: Page 4
content_zh:
「夫君？」一直安静端坐在喜床上的小新娘怯生生地出声了，声音嫩声嫩气，虽然力图端庄，却显然还带着几分娃娃音。

原四公子被人玩弄得团团转，心里气愤不平，刚才把伺候在洞房里的喜娘和丫鬟都赶出去了，如今房间里只剩下他和小新娘两人，两人还未喝交杯酒，大婚的礼仪就不算完成，小新娘显然是有些焦急不安了。

夜深人静，如果就这样耗下去，那他们的婚事算不算完成呀？而且……小新娘子坐在床上不着痕迹地动了动，她已经端端正正在床上坐了大半天了，腿脚麻木了不说，更迫切的是想解决一下生理问题。

小新娘子的脸还遮在红盖头下，她有些委屈地扁了扁小嘴，虽然娘亲说出嫁从夫，要做个乖顺体贴的妻子，不要事事自己拿主张，可是……她现在真的很难受啊，夫君为什么不理她呢？是不是讨厌她？

这样一想，顾惜恩就更难过了，小脑袋越垂越低，就在她眼睛泛红，眼泪快要滚下来时，眼前陡然一亮，她有些不适应地赶紧闭上了眼，好一会儿才慢慢地抬起脸，睁开了眼睛。

眼前的男人好高大挺拔，好俊美！

一身火红的新郎服也能被原平之穿出玉树临风的翩翩风采，再加上他身材高？偏瘦，宽肩窄腰，玉带在细腰上一束，更显得腰细腿长，怎么看怎么好看。

只是，他的脸色很严肃冷峻……呜……他果然是不喜欢她的！

小新娘子眨着水汪汪的大眼睛，小脸也越来越寒，樱桃般的小嘴也严肃地紧抿着，胆怯又勇敢地和原平之对视着。

原平之则是满心惊讶与赞叹，说实话，他早已经不记得顾惜恩的模样了，还以为依然是个没什么看头的黄毛小丫头，可此时呈现在他眼前的却是一张明眸皓齿、眉目如画的绝美脸蛋，虽然她的小脸蛋还有些鼓鼓的婴儿肥，却已经可以想象日后完全长大时，将是如何的倾国倾城。

小丫头的肌肤白里透粉，粉中透红，嫩得好像一掐就能掐出一把水来，白皙光滑毫无瑕疵，让原平之甚至很想咬一咬。她乌黑的眼珠认真又胆怯地望着他，小嘴微微嘟着，漂亮可爱极了。

原平之努力板着脸，辛苦地维持自己贵公子的体面，千万不能在小毛丫头面前露出丢脸好色的狼样。

他的心底甚至在哀号，爹娘这到底是疼爱他还是整他？知道他爱美女，就专门为他挑选一个这样的绝色，可绝色佳人他是喜欢，但能不能年纪不要这么小？他不是好色无度的猥琐老男人，对着这么一个胸前还平平坦坦的小丫头，就算再美，他又怎么吃得下去？

他不要做禽兽啊！

原平之心里如同滚沸的水，各种念头滚过来滚过去。

顾惜恩嘟了嘟小嘴，小声道：「夫君？我想更衣。」

「啊？喔！」原平之总算从玄昱附体的好色状态中恢复，低声咳嗽了两下，转身朝门外喊道：「和冰，和玉，进来伺候。」

一直守候在门外的喜娘和丫鬟们松了口气，看来四公子还没有被气昏头，不会拿小新娘子出气了。

门被推开，原平之的两个大丫鬟和冰、和玉一起走进来，分别对新婚的夫妻二人施礼。

原平之转头又问顾惜恩：「你的陪嫁丫头叫什么？是不是叫她们来伺候？」

他担心顾惜恩初来乍到，不好意思让和冰和玉伺候近身的私密之事。

顾惜恩看看比自己高一个头的和冰、和玉，见她们二人都是正当妙龄，貌美如花，心里有些惴惴不安，嫩嫩地答道：「我总共有八个陪嫁丫鬟，四个大丫鬟，四个小丫头，还有一个奶娘、两个嬷嬷，大丫鬟今天是秋水和秋月当值。」

「那就让秋水、秋月进来伺候吧。」原平之立即吩咐，又说：「和冰、和玉，叫人准备好热水，和秋水、秋月伺候少夫人沐浴。」

「是。」

一阵纷纷扰扰之后，原平之先沐浴完毕，他换了身淡紫色的常服，头发松散地披在肩上，只在末尾松松地用丝带系了两下，俊美新郎变成了慵懒贵公子，懒洋洋地坐在喜桌前，白皙如玉的修长手指敲着椅子扶手，若有所思地望着龙凤喜烛。

不久，顾惜恩也梳洗完毕，她走进卧室，见夫君懒洋洋笑咪咪地坐在椅子上看她，不由顿了一下。

她的个子娇小，站挺了也没到原平之的下巴，现在刚刚沐浴完，浓妆退去，小脸粉嫩，更是孩子气。

原平之在心底又是叹又是笑又是怜，也不忍心再难为这个努力扮作大人的小丫头，对她招手道：「饿了一天吧？快来吃点东西。」

顾惜恩端庄地点点头，走到桌子前，可当她想坐下时，因为桌子高椅子也高，她的腿还有点短，试了两下也没坐上去，她只好偷偷踮起脚尖，仍然上身挺直端正着，可小脸已经憋得泛红。正当她暗自着急时，一双大手从前面抱起了她，卡在她的腋下，将她悬空提上了椅子。

顾惜恩坐好之后，两只小脚悬空，她的小脸更红了，却努力严肃认真地对原平之道：「谢谢夫君。」

原平之原本看她一板一眼的样子很好玩，现在却莫名觉得小丫头可爱得要命，忍不住伸手捏了捏她的粉颊，果然光滑溜溜的，十分好摸。

「夫……夫君！」小丫头更窘迫了，脸红得如同霞染。

原平之咳嗽一声，说：「很饿了吧，先喝点粥吧。」

顾惜恩看看面前的红枣花生桂圆莲子粥，小声道：「要先喝交杯酒的。」

原平之「啊」了一声，见她望着自己的眼睛满是认真和渴望，他虽然觉得这场婚礼如同玩笑，可是对于小丫头来说，大概是她人生里最严肃的一件事了吧？

原平之转头看了看喜娘，说：「你们来伺候吧，该怎么做就怎么做。」

一直在旁的喜娘大喜，急忙上前伺候，分别为新郎新娘斟了酒，在两人交缠双臂喝酒时，唱了夫妻恩爱白首偕老祝酒歌，再唱多福多子歌，最后请新娘子喝「早生贵子」粥，洞房里的流程总算走完了。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

原平之此时也放下心来，就着一些清爽可口的菜蔬，配上糯米粥狠狠吃了一顿。他一天忙碌，也是没吃什么东西，而且原本心情乱糟糟的，没什么胃口，此时却不知道为何，看着小丫头粉嫩嫩的小脸，顿时就有了胃口。佳人虽小，绝色已初现，看起来秀色可餐。

原平之一边鄙夷自己的男人劣根性，一边继续大快朵颐，顾惜恩却吃相斯文，显然教养极佳。

原平之道：「饿了就大口大口地吃，不用拿捏。」

顾惜恩看了看他，难以想象外人心目中最优雅俊美的原四公子，私底下其实相当不拘小节。

顾惜恩道：「我习惯了的。」

原平之笑了笑，道：「你娘一定想把你教养成最优雅的闺秀，平时没少吃了苦头吧？」

第2章(2)

这个话题一出口，原平之就意识到了不对，如今升平大长公主身体不好，只怕顾惜恩想起来就会伤心。他一抬头，果然见顾惜恩的筷子停了下来，眼圈有点泛红，可是她努力压抑着自己的情绪，显然不想破坏洞房花烛夜的喜庆。

过了好一会儿，她才认真回答道：「你说错了，娘从未特意拘束过我，她只教了我一个道理，就是要快乐地长大，快乐地生活。」
content_en:
"Husband?" The little bride, who had been sitting quietly on the wedding bed, timidly spoke up. Her voice was soft and tender. Although she tried to be dignified, it still had a bit of a baby voice.

The former Fourth Young Master was being played around with and was very angry. He had just kicked out Xi Niang and the maids who were serving in the wedding room. Now he and the young bride were the only ones left in the room. The wedding etiquette was not completed before they had a drink. The young bride was obviously a little anxious.

In the dead of night, if it goes on like this, will their marriage be considered complete?And... the little bride sat on the bed and moved without leaving a trace. She had been sitting upright on the bed for most of the day. Not only her legs and feet were numb, but more urgently she wanted to solve her physical problem.

The young bride's face was still covered by the red hijab, and she flattened her mouth a little aggrievedly. Although her mother said that she should obey her husband when she married, and that she should be an obedient and considerate wife, and not make her own decisions in everything, but...she was really feeling uncomfortable now. Why did her husband ignore her?Do you hate her?

Thinking of this, Gu Xien became even more sad. Her little head hung lower and lower. Just when her eyes were red and tears were about to roll down, her eyes suddenly lit up. She quickly closed her eyes with some discomfort. After a while, she slowly raised her face and opened her eyes.

The man in front of me is so tall, upright, and handsome!

A fiery red groom's suit can also be worn by Yuan Pingzhi to look like Yushu Linfeng, plus he is tall?She is on the thin side, with wide shoulders and narrow waist. A jade belt is tied around her thin waist, which makes her waist appear thinner and her legs longer. She looks good no matter how you look at her.

However, his face was very serious and cold... ugh... he really didn't like her!

The young bride blinked her big watery eyes, her little face became colder and colder, and her cherry-like mouth tightened solemnly, looking at Yuan Pingzhi timidly yet bravely.

Yuan Pingzhi was filled with surprise and admiration. To be honest, he had long forgotten what Gu Xien looked like. He thought she was still a little girl with yellow hair and nothing to look at. But what appeared in front of him now was a beautiful face with bright eyes, white teeth and picturesque features. Although her little face still had some bulging baby fat, he could already imagine how stunning she would be when she grew up.

The little girl's skin was white and pink, with a pink inside and a pink inside. It was so tender that it seemed like you could squeeze out a handful of water with just a pinch. It was white, smooth and flawless, and Yuan Pingzhi even wanted to take a bite.Her dark eyes looked at him seriously and timidly, her little mouth pouted slightly, she was so beautiful and cute.

Yuan Pingzhi tried hard to keep a straight face and worked hard to maintain his respectability as a noble son. He must not show his shameful and lustful wolfish behavior in front of the little girl.

He was even wailing in his heart, were his parents loving him or punishing him?Knowing that he loves beautiful women, he specially selected such a stunning beauty for him. But he likes stunning beauties, but can he not be so young?He is not a lustful and wretched old man. For such a little girl with a flat chest, no matter how beautiful she is, how can he eat her?

He doesn't want to be a beast!

Yuan Ping's heart was like boiling water, with various thoughts rolling back and forth.

Gu Xien pouted and whispered, "Husband? I want to change my clothes."

"Ah? Oh!" Yuan Pingzhi finally recovered from the lustful state possessed by Xuan Yu, coughed twice in a low voice, turned around and shouted out the door: "He Bing, He Yu, come in and wait."

Xi Niang and the maids who had been waiting outside the door breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that the Fourth Young Master was not mad yet and would not take it out on the young bride.

The door was pushed open, and Yuan Pingzhi's two maids, Bing and Heyu, walked in and saluted the newlyweds respectively.

Yuan Pingzhi turned to Gu Xi'en and asked: "What is the name of your dowry girl? Do you want them to serve you?"

He was worried that Gu Xien had just arrived and was embarrassed to let He Bing and Yu take care of his personal affairs.

Gu Xien looked at He Bing and He Yu, who were a head taller than her, and saw that both of them were in their prime and as beautiful as flowers. She felt a little uneasy and replied tenderly: "I have a total of eight dowry maids, four eldest maids, four little maids, a wet nurse, and two nuns. The eldest maid is on duty today for Qiu Shui and Qiu Yue."

"Then let Qiu Shui and Qiu Yue come in and take care of you." Yuan Pingzhi immediately ordered, and then said: "He Bing and He Yu, ask people to prepare hot water, and Qiu Shui and Qiu Yue will take care of the young lady to take a bath."

"Yes."

After a while of commotion, Yuan Pingzhi finished his bath first and changed into lavender clothes. His hair was loosely draped over his shoulders, only loosely tied twice with a ribbon at the end. The handsome groom turned into a lazy nobleman, sitting lazily in front of the wedding table. His long, white and jade-like fingers tapped on the armrests of the chair, looking thoughtfully at the dragon and phoenix wedding candles.

Soon, Gu Xi'en also finished washing. She walked into the bedroom and saw her husband sitting on the chair and looking at her lazily and smiling. She couldn't help but pause.

She is petite and even when she stands straight, she does not even reach Yuan Pingzhi's chin. Now that she has just finished taking a shower, her heavy makeup has faded, and her face is pink and even more childlike.

Yuan Pingzhi sighed, laughed and felt pity in his heart. He couldn't bear to make things harder for this little girl who was trying so hard to pretend to be an adult. He waved to her and said, "Have you been hungry all day? Come and have something to eat."

Gu Xien nodded solemnly and walked to the table, but when she wanted to sit down, because the table was high and the chair was high, her legs were still a bit short, so she couldn't sit down even after two attempts. She had to secretly stand on tiptoes, keeping her upper body upright, but her face was already red from suppressing it.Just when she was secretly anxious, a pair of big hands picked her up from the front, stuck her under her armpits, and lifted her onto the chair.

After Gu Xien sat down, her little feet were dangling in the air. Her little face turned even redder, but she tried her best to say to Yuan Ping seriously, "Thank you, husband."

Yuan Pingzhi was originally amused by her serious look, but now he felt that the little girl was extremely cute. He couldn't help but reach out and pinch her pink cheeks. As expected, they were smooth and very easy to touch.

"Husband...husband!" The little girl was even more embarrassed, her face was as red as Xia Ran.

Yuan Pingzhi coughed and said, "You must be very hungry. Let's drink some porridge first."

Gu Xien looked at the red date, peanut, longan, and lotus seed porridge in front of her, and whispered, "I want to drink a glass of wine first."

Yuan Pingzhi said "Ah" and saw her eyes looking at him full of seriousness and longing. Although he thought this wedding was a joke, for the little girl, it was probably the most serious event in her life, right?

Yuan Pingzhi turned to look at Xi Niang and said, "You guys come and serve me. Just do whatever you want."

The bride, who had been by the side, was overjoyed and hurriedly came forward to serve the bride and groom. They poured wine for the bride and groom respectively. While the two of them intertwined their arms and drank, they sang a toast to the love of husband and wife and a long life together, and then sang a song of blessings and many children. Finally, she invited the bride to drink the porridge "Have a Son Soon". The process in the bridal chamber was finally completed.

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

Yuan Pingzhi felt relieved at this time and had a hearty meal with some fresh and delicious vegetables and glutinous rice porridge.He had a busy day and didn't eat much. He was originally in a messy mood and had no appetite. But now for some reason, he suddenly felt an appetite when he looked at the little girl's pink and tender face.Although the beauty is young, her stunning beauty has already begun to appear, and she looks delicious.

While Yuan Pingzhi despised his bad nature as a man, he continued to feast, while Gu Xien ate gracefully, obviously well-educated.

Yuan Ping's way: "When you're hungry, just eat big mouthfuls without having to worry about it."

Gu Xien looked at him and found it hard to imagine that the former Fourth Young Master, whom outsiders thought was the most elegant and handsome, was actually quite informal in private.

Gu Xien said: "I'm used to it."

Yuan Pingzhi smiled and said: "Your mother must want to raise you to be the most elegant lady. She has suffered a lot, right?"

Chapter 2(2)

As soon as this topic came out, Yuan Pingzhi realized that something was wrong. Now that the eldest princess Shengping was in poor health, she was afraid that Gu Xien would be sad just thinking about it.When he looked up, he saw that Gu Xien's chopsticks had stopped, and her eye circles were a little red, but she tried hard to suppress her emotions, obviously not wanting to ruin the joy of the wedding night.

After a while, she replied seriously: "You are wrong. Mom has never restrained me. She only taught me one thing, which is to grow up happily and live happily."
